Questions to Explore

  • Do higher-activity airports tend to have more direct connections?
  • Which activity levels appear in highly connected parts of the network?
  • How do neighborhoods of different activity quartiles compare?

Data Limitations

  • Airport names and geographic coordinates are not provided.
  • Node positions are algorithmic, not geographic.
  • Node size represents degree derived from network edges.
  • Connectivity does not establish causality with activity level.
